content.comment_body: Is it possible for communication between [product_name] [article_no] / [article_no] and the key panel KP8?
Hello, Discussion about HMI KP8 and [product_name] [article_no] can be found on the forum at [company_name] Support.
Hi, I don't think this combination works. As far as I know, KP8 only supports Profinet, but [product_name] does not support Profinet. So, I believe it will not work. Hope this helps.
